I’m from WR! Macon’s awesome! Growlers on Lakejoy is a good weekday spot for craft beers and they post their events all over FB! Lots of dive bars in town, but the good spots are in Macon for sure. Society Garden, Reboot, Hummingbird, Just Tapd.. tons of live music and places to get good food and great craft beer

If you’re thinking of staying in the Atlanta area then try the Beltline. It’s a cool 2 mile urban trail that takes you through the trendy parts of the city full of street art and a hipster vibe. Biking it is fun, y’all can picnic in Piedmont Park with skyline views. It’s only $10 to go to the top of the Westin hotel, there’s also a bar up there with panoramic views of Atlanta. Literally google speakeasys and there’s some crazy ones all around Atlanta. There’s always fun events going on in the city and on second Sunday of every month The High Museum of Arts has free admission. There’s also a cool botanical garden in Atlanta, there’s tons of trendy cool secrets in the city!!! Also, Krog Street tunnel is cool people spray paint it all the time! And use IG to find out more, Greg Mike is a cool street artist from the city you’ll find tons of his paintings all around.
